input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere: the outline has no insurance heading, a full-text search for "insur"/"coverage"/"certificate" returns only an unrelated reference to "mortgage insurers" in the recitals, and the miscellaneous provisions (Sections 13-30) end at Force Majeure without any coverage requirement. TrueLink is a hosting vendor that hosts the Web Site and transmits/processes Client data and credit repository information, so the rule expects insurance and the absence falls into walk-away territory (no insurance for a vendor processing personal data). We inserted a new Section 31 at the preferred position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request), placed after Section 30 and before the signature block; the comment offers the fallback limits (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) if the vendor pushes back.

ops.text: 31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance provision, as TrueLink hosts the Web Site and processes Client data but the Agreement currently requires no coverage. We can discuss reduced limits (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) if the higher limits are an issue.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 31 requiring TrueLink to carry CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation insurance with certificates on request.
